description.zh-CN: AWS S3 可留空；MinIO、R2 等填写完整 HTTPS 地址。
description.en-US: Leave empty for AWS S3; enter the full HTTPS URL for MinIO, R2, or another compatible service.

description.zh-CN: 服务商要求的区域；AWS 填 Bucket 所在区域，R2 通常填 auto。
description.en-US: Provider region; use the bucket region for AWS and commonly auto for Cloudflare R2.

description.zh-CN: 必填。填写已创建且当前凭据有读写权限的 Bucket 名称。
description.en-US: Required. Enter an existing bucket that the current credentials can read and write.

description.zh-CN: 与 Secret Access Key 成对填写；只有使用 AWS 默认凭据链时两项都留空。
description.en-US: Enter together with Secret Access Key; leave both empty only when using the AWS default credential chain.

description.zh-CN: 与 Access Key ID 成对填写。密钥加密保存，编辑时留空会保留原值。
description.en-US: Enter together with Access Key ID. The secret is encrypted at rest; leave it empty while editing to keep the saved value.

description.zh-CN: 可选。用于把论坛附件放进 Bucket 的指定目录，不要以斜杠开头。
description.en-US: Optional. Stores forum attachments under a bucket prefix; do not start it with a slash.

description.zh-CN: MinIO 等自建服务通常需要开启。
description.en-US: Commonly required by self-hosted MinIO endpoints.

description.zh-CN: 可选 CDN 或公开 Bucket 地址；留空时公开附件仍走 Host 代理。
description.en-US: Optional CDN or public bucket URL; leave empty to use the Host content proxy.
